name: Retraction Watch Database (distributed by Crossref)
publisher: The Center for Scientific Integrity, distributed by Crossref
description: The hand-curated census of retractions, expressions of concern and corrections - over 72,000 notices with the retracted paper's DOI, the notice's DOI, dates, country, subject and a coded reason field spanning 112 reasons. Since 2023 Crossref distributes it free under CC0; before that it was a paid licence.

access.auth_note: the email goes in the query string, with no key and no name: ?you@example.com
access.size_hint: ~66 MB CSV, 72,389 rows as of September 2026
access.etiquette: one download gets the whole database - do not poll it

probes.description: The whole database. Ranged so the probe costs 4 KB, not 66 MB.
probes.note: api.labs.crossref.org generates the CSV on request and 502s under load; it answered in 7 s and 502'd 20 minutes later on 2026-09-06. Retry before concluding anything.

recipes.title: Download and count by reason

gotchas.trap: 'Investigation by Journal/Publisher' is the single most common Reason value, and it is a process marker, not a cause. Charting reasons without dropping it produces a meaningless top bar.
gotchas.fix: Treat the process markers (investigation by journal, by third party, by company) separately from substantive reasons.

gotchas.trap: The file is UTF-8 with a BOM.
gotchas.fix: Open with encoding='utf-8-sig' or the first column name comes back with a leading zero-width character.

gotchas.trap: Joining to OpenAlex on the raw DOI string fails often - case and https://doi.org/ prefixes differ between the two.
gotchas.fix: Normalise to lowercase bare DOI on both sides. That matched 59,971 of 72,389 in September 2026.
